name: Kenvi Jewels Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2002, Kenvi Jewels does trading of precious metals and jewelry[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of manufacturing, wholesaling and retailing of jewelry. The designing of jewelry is done in house which is manufactured at its manufacturing unit. Further, company also gets its jewelry designed by third party designers as and when required. Company sells gold jewelry made with or without studded diamonds, precious and semiprecious stones. Its retail business is done through its own showroom in Odhav, Ahmedabad

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 39.4 days to 25.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.63% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -7.15%
